annotations.title: When a genre formed in the prose, and when its name caught on

description: For 'when did detective fiction emerge', 'when did people start saying "Gothic novel"', 'is mystery fiction just detective fiction renamed', 'what genres are there'. The prose cluster (when it first forms, its novels, earliest and latest) and the genre-name clock from Google Books (first attested, the years it reached 10% and half of its mentions, the peak, mentions per billion words every 20 years). Leave genre empty to list every genre and clock.

genre.description: A genre or its name, e.g. 'detective fiction', 'gothic novel', 'sea story', 'western'. Empty = list all.
